conclusion: No exact training membership decision is possible for all 1198 clips from the inspected public resources. Supporting held-out evidence exists; leakage is neither demonstrated nor ruled out.

public_test_matching.method: Unique exact project-normalized reference plus duration within 0.001001 seconds. No hypotheses, fuzzy matching or inferred numeric rewriting used.
public_test_matching.interpretation: Supporting candidates in the authors' test output table, not verified training exclusions. Absence of a candidate is not training membership.

authors_statements.section_3_3: Existing train/validation/test assignments kept; duplicate audio and duplicate held-out sentences checked, according to the authors.
authors_statements.section_5_1: Whisper fine-tuned on the same training split as the other adapted models.
authors_statements.limitations: Inherited splits not guaranteed speaker-disjoint; not evidence by itself of exact clip leakage.
